info.syllabusName: Marketing Nhà hàng khách sạn (Hospitality Marketing)
info.description:
Hospitality Marketing is equipped with basic knowledge and advanced marketing in the field of hospitality and tourism, helping students to understand the importance of marketing in hotel business as well as new trends in the world, knowledge of the business environment and important information about marketing in the hospitality and tourism sector. Throughout the course, students can understand and anticipate customer behavior, market segmentation, target market identification and product positioning in accordance with the business environment of hotel and tourism. In addition, students have access to the steps to develop marketing plans suitable for business, planning and research on marketing for the next year.

During the learning process, learners will be able to exchange, discuss and solve related issues through marketing situations of enterprises so that they can better visualize marketing activities in restaurants, hotels and tourism business
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Identify appropriate marketing tools to the field, apply rational concepts and theories of marketing into the hospitality environment, apply this knowledge to design the right marketing strategies for corporates; and connect the knowledge of this subject with other specialized subjects in the field of Marketing Management and Business Administration-specialized in Hospitality industry.

Analyze the corporate marketing issues in the field of hospitality; At the same time, they can analyze and select the appropriate communication tools, bring high efficiency for the campaign of corporate communication in the field of hospitality.
Students can self-assess their marketing strategies while developing creative thinking, exploring, and developing their own marketing plans.

Students should be proactive  in  subject study, in approaching and solving problems related to marketing in the field of hospitality; At the same time, it is right to recognize and evaluate a marketing strategy of hospitality corporates. In addition, students are also provided with lessons on the ethical values of marketing in the hospitality environment.
